text:
maya: FYI, PR #18912 (reduce buffer retention) is blocked by CI — intermittent OOM on integ shard-5. I kicked a rerun but wanted to ping for eyes / plan. Logs show `exit code 137` in the test process.

chris: Can you paste the failing test name? I can try a targeted rerun.

maya: test is `tests/perf/test_memory_pressure.py::test_kv_persistence`. Failure stack: 
```
Killed
/usr/local/bin/python -m pytest tests/perf/test_memory_pressure.py::test_kv_persistence -q
...alloc failed, needed 1600000000 bytes
Process killed with signal 9 (OOM)
```
Happens only on shard-5 in CI (two different runs). Not reproducing locally so far.

ci-bot: buildkite: job pr-18912-shard-5 (build 4821) failed — exit code 137. Targeted reruns available.

sasha: This looks nondeterministic. If it's only on shard-5 maybe it's an infra noise / noisy machine. I'd avoid a snapshot update here — snapshots won't help OOM.

chris: I'll kick a targeted rerun for shard-5 and watch. If it flakes again we should decide whether to either add a small stability tweak to the test or skip on shard-5 temporarily.

chris: `/ci rerun targeted 18912 shard-5`

ci-bot: OK — targeted rerun requested for pr-18912 on shard-5. Queue position: 2.

ci-bot: Targeted rerun finished: pr-18912-shard-5 (run 4823) — FAILED (exit code 137).

maya: ugh — failed again. Two failures, both OOM at similar point. Not seeing obvious memory leak in the code change.

leo: Is the test allocating a large dataset? Could we reduce concurrency or the retained buffer size in the test harness? Quick patch to shed a bit of memory could make the flake less likely.

sasha: If we add a temporary test tweak we should mark it with a TODO and reference this thread. That lets us merge without snapshot tricks and follow up with better root-cause. Also we need one approval from backend team for the change.

chris: I can try a minimal test change: lower `num_workers` from 8 to 4 in the test and re-run targeted. If that stabilizes we can merge and file a follow-up to investigate infra variance.

maya: fine by me, thanks. Can you also include a short comment in the test explaining it's a temporary flap reduction?

chris: will do. kicking another targeted after patch. `/ci rerun targeted 18912 shard-5` after push.

ci-bot: Received new run for pr-18912-shard-5 (run 4827) — in progress.

ci-bot: Run 4827 — SUCCESS. All shard jobs green.

sasha: Great. Once we have the change documented I'm fine approving. @chris can you leave a link to the follow-up issue for proper triage?

chris: Added comment and created issue #3426: "Investigate intermittent OOM in test_kv_persistence on shard-5" and referenced PR. Pushed test tweak and note.

maya: Thanks. I still want a thumbs-up from backend — @sasha if you can approve when you have a sec? I want to avoid merge conflicts with the upcoming release window.

sasha: Approving now :thumbsup: — will merge once CI finishes final gating.

ci-bot: Merge gate passed. pr-18912 merged by maya.

leo: Follow-up: let's add a telemetry check to the perf tests to surface memory peaks; file #3426 covers that. Good ops.

maya: thanks everyone for quick help. We'll track the follow-up and revert the test tweak if/when we fix the root cause.

chris: marking this thread resolved on my side.

sasha: same.

ci-bot: NOTE: Automated note — reruns and targeted merges recorded in buildkite history for audit.
